text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: —Are you serious...?!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Yes!
Ikuno Dictus's achievements over this past year have been highly recognized—

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
The URA has officially decided to
honor Ikuno Dictus with the title of
"Best Senior Queen Umamusume"!

"Best Queen Umamusume" is a title awarded to Umamusume
who excelled in races like the Hanshin JF,
the Triple Tiara, and the Queen Elizabeth II Cup.

Slots have been established for the Junior, Classic, and Senior stages,
which means Ikuno Dictus will be selected for the Senior Class...!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Actually, I wanted to consult with the two of you
about something related to that matter...

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: Recently, a proposal was sent to the Academy from Ikuno Dictus's fans.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: We'd like to hold an event to celebrate having safely run through so many races—

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: Goodness...! Such an offer—

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
This is just a suggestion from here on, but if you'd like,
how about holding this event
under the guise of celebrating the award?

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
We thought it would be a wonderful opportunity for Ikuno Dictus-san
to interact with her fans, and for the fans to congratulate
the two of you in person...
choice_data_list: That sounds great...! What do you think, Ikuno?

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
If possible, I would certainly love to do so.
It is an extremely valuable opportunity, after all.
And so, an event was organized in honor of Ikuno Dictus being named 'Best Senior Queen Umamusume'...

text_block_list.name: Event MC
text_block_list.text:
Now, without further ado, let's welcome her to the stage!
The crowned "Best Senior Queen Umamusume,"
Ikuno Dictus!!
(WOOOOOOOH!!!!)

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Fan A
text_block_list.text:
—Ikuno Dictus-!!
Congratulations--!!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Fan B
text_block_list.text: Thank you so muuuuch for all the unforgettable moments!!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: (There are so many fans...!)

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
—Everyone, thank you so much
for gathering here today.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
To receive congratulations from so many people like this...
I am truly, deeply happy.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
I hope to hear from as many of you as possible today,
so please... lend me your support.
Afterward, a fan meet-and-greet event conceived by Ikuno Dictus was held—

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Fan C
text_block_list.text:
“—Seeing you bravely take on races at any distance
gave me so much courage...!
Please keep doing your best from now on, without pushing yourself too hard...!”

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: Thank you for your consideration.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
So that I may continue to give you courage,
I intend to do my best in my own way.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Fan D
text_block_list.text:
"U-Um...! To tell the truth, for a while now...
I've wanted to see what you look like without glasses...!
I was just thinking...!"

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Fan D
text_block_list.text:
I-I know it might be impolite of me to ask, but...!
I-If it's alright with you...!!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: I don't mind at all. It's no trouble.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: How about it?

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Fan D
text_block_list.text:
*gasp*...! It feels so different from your
usual look... You look so gallant and dignified...!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much.
I'm so happy.
And so, Ikuno Dictus continued to happily interact with her fans—
—And near the end of the event...

text_block_list.name: Event MC
text_block_list.text:
And now! From all your fans,
we have a present for you,
Ikuno Dictus-san!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: A present...?

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Fans
text_block_list.text: “““Ready, set...!!”””
What the fans unfurled in front of Ikuno Dictus was an enormous banner.

Beside a sprinting Ikuno Dictus,
the words "The Iron Woman, Ikuno Dictus"
were written in powerful, striking calligraphy...!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: Whoa...!!

text_block_list.name: Fan Representative
text_block_list.text:
"We will continue to cheer for you
as you keep running tough races...!"

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
......Everyone.
To think you would make something like this for me...
Truly, thank you so much.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Please continue to expect great things from me.
From the running of Ikuno Dictus, the "Iron Woman"!!
(WOOOOOOOH!!!!)
And so, Ikuno Dictus's fan event concluded without a hitch—

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: —Excuse me.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for waiting, Trainer.
Ikuno Dictus, the "Iron Woman," at your service.
choice_data_list: Hey, that looks great on you!

text_block_list.text:
She must have been exceptionally fond of the nickname given by her fans,
as Ikuno Dictus continued to introduce herself
this way for quite some time—
